title: Milei Announces Sanctions on British Companies and New Naval Base Over Malvinas Dispute
detail: President Javier Milei escalated Argentina's Malvinas/Falklands sovereignty campaign in a nationwide address, announcing targeted sanctions against British companies operating in disputed waters and unveiling plans to construct a new Argentine naval base to reinforce the country's sovereignty claim. The move marks the sharpest diplomatic confrontation with the UK since the 1982 war.
